paper_title: Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge An Ever-Scaling   Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs
caption: Ever-scalingness
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the distribution of characteristics associated with a challenge benchmark for Large Language Models, labeled as “Ever-scalingness”. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different attribute. A yellow slice is labeled “Uncrushable” and occupies approximately 15% of the total area. Adjacent to it is a red slice labeled “Scalable Oversight”, which appears to be roughly 20% of the chart. Below that is an orange slice labeled “Auto-verifiable”, taking up approximately 15% of the space. A blue slice labeled "Unhackable" accounts for about 25% of the chart, while a green slice labeled “Coverage” occupies approximately 20%. Finally, there is a smaller green slice labeled “General” which seems to account for around 5% of the chart. Each slice includes a small icon alongside its label. There is no explicit legend, and no percentage labels are present within the slices; however, the slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise orientation based on size.
